```sql
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT MAX(ordered_at) AS max_ordered_at FROM jaffle_shop.dev.orders
),
customer_region AS (
  SELECT o.customer_id, o.location_id
  FROM jaffle_shop.dev.orders o
  WHERE o.customer_order_number = 1
),
customer_status AS (
  SELECT
    cr.customer_id,
    cr.location_id,
    CASE WHEN julianday(l.max_ordered_at) - julianday(c.last_ordered_at) > 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_churned
  FROM customer_region cr
  JOIN jaffle_shop.dev.customers c ON c.customer_id = cr.customer_id
  CROSS JOIN latest l
)
SELECT
  loc.location_id,
  loc.location_name AS region,
  COUNT(cs.customer_id) AS total_customers,
  SUM(cs.is_churned) AS churned_customers,
  1.0 * SUM(cs.is_churned) / COUNT(cs.customer_id) AS churn_rate
FROM customer_status cs
JOIN jaffle_shop.dev.locations loc ON loc.location_id = cs.location_id
GROUP BY loc.location_id, loc.location_name
ORDER BY churn_rate DESC
LIMIT 500
```
